summary:
Verified prerender.js race-condition fix: (a) code review confirms correct do/while retry loop (max 3 attempts, delays 400/1200/2000ms, throws after 3 failed attempts, off-by-one safe); (b) ran full `yarn build` (450s) — exit 0, output shows 'Prerendered 221/221 routes successfully.' with NO 'FAILED' list and 'Sitemap generated with 221 URLs.'; (c) `grep -rl '
' /app/frontend/build --include=index.html | wc -l` returns 0 (zero empty-root snapshots); (d) all 3 previously-broken routes (/service-areas, /resources/cybersecurity-predictions-2027, /cyber-risk-scorecard) now contain real rendered content matching their expected identifiers. Homepage Preview regression screenshot confirms live dev-server app still renders normally (root innerHTML ~448k chars, correct title).
critical_code_review_comments: prerender.js retry logic is correct: attempt counter increments after content capture; loop terminates after 3 attempts (attempt values 1,2,3 -> delays 400/1200/2000ms); post-loop guard throws so failures land in FAILED list rather than being silently persisted — matches intent described in review request.

Minor (non-blocking): the empty-root detection string 'id="root">' is tightly coupled to serialization output; if React ever renders a whitespace-only child or a comment placeholder, detection would miss it. Consider stricter check via `page.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('root').children.length === 0)`. Not urgent — current fix works against the observed Puppeteer serialization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build pipeline fix verified end-to-end. yarn build takes ~7.5 min total; run in background (nohup ... &) and poll /tmp/build.log rather than waiting synchronously. All 221 routes prerender cleanly, sitemap has 221 URLs, no empty-root artifacts remain.
rca of the issue:
Race condition in prerender.js: React occasionally hadn't finished mounting into #root when Puppeteer captured page.content() after networkidle0 + fixed 400ms settle, producing an empty
shell that was silently written as a successful prerender snapshot. Fix adds a do/while retry loop (up to 3 attempts, progressive settle delays 400/1200/2000ms) that detects the empty-root serialization string and throws if still empty after 3 tries, so real failures now surface in the FAILED list. Verified 0 empty-root files across all 221 routes post-build.
